d-Al3CuNi and c-Al7Cu4Ni and other heat-resistant phase constitute a closed or semi-closed network structure (Fig. 1a and c), which would exert dragging effect to gain boundary motion at high temperature and thus would lead to an improvement of high temperature strength.

These Ni-rich phases and other heat-resistant phases constitute a closed or semi-closed network, which would exert dragging effect to gain boundary motion at high temperature and thus would result in an improvement of high temperature strength.
In particular, the UTS of Ni1 alloy (with only 0.8 wt.% Ni content) is high to 97 MPa, 32 MPa higher than that of Ni0 alloy (65 MPa, without Ni addition).
